findings.evidence: src/lib/auth.ts imports next-auth, next-auth/providers/credentials, and bcryptjs; src/lib/db.ts imports @prisma/adapter-pg - none of these external packages are listed or flagged in this doc's Dependencies section. No package.json is present in codeFiles to confirm them. By contrast, the sibling docs/modules/app/README.md and docs/modules/types/README.md, generated in the same run, both end their Dependencies sections with an explicit '[NEEDS CLARIFICATION] No package.json is present in inputs.code, so external package dependencies ... cannot be confirmed' disclaimer, even though lib is the module with the most external-package usage (next-auth, bcryptjs, @prisma/adapter-pg).
findings.message: The Dependencies section covers only internal module dependencies (app, types) and omits any mention of this module's external package dependencies (next-auth, bcryptjs, @prisma/adapter-pg), unlike the sibling app/README.md and types/README.md which explicitly flag the missing package.json as a clarification gap for external deps.
